content: 特朗普向记者表示，他将前往中国，并预计与习近平及普京会面。他说：“我将前往中国，而我认为其中一场会议将会是与普京总统及习近平主席举行，这将会很有意思。”他又表示，会谈将涉及多项议题，包括核裁军及结束伊朗战争。 中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方正与有关方面就三国元首会晤保持沟通。俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）证实，相关协调工作正在进行，希望未来数日内敲定安排。他说：“我们希望能在未来几天内敲定这件事。” 克里姆林宫早于10月21日已表示，三方会谈正在筹备。美国《华尔街日报》此前报道，普京希望透过会谈促成乌克兰和平协议，争取对莫斯科有利的安排。俄罗斯自2022年全面入侵乌克兰后，一直面对西方国家的外交孤立及制裁。 分析人士指出，普京可能是这场会谈的最大受益者。即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 美国前总统奥巴马（Barack Obama）政府时期的国务院高级官员丹尼·罗素（Danny Russel）向Euronews表示，普京是最有可能从三方会谈中获益的领袖，即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 俄罗斯方面也明显积极推动会面。他形容，这将是普京的一次“外交上的重大胜利”。 莫斯科政治分析人士亚历山大·布拉特斯基（Alexander Bratersky）接受半岛电视台访问时指出，三方会谈本身已足以让俄罗斯取得政治宣传成果。俄罗斯官员曾将这类会谈比作1945年的雅尔塔会议，暗示大国领袖可共同塑造战后国际秩序。布拉特斯基认为，普京与特朗普及习近平同坐谈判桌，有助塑造俄罗斯参与决定欧洲未来安全架构的形象。他说：“单是举行这场会议，本身就是一项成功。普京将能够在国内将此事作为成果宣传。” 特朗普方面则希望借会谈展示其处理国际重大问题的能力。伦敦城市圣乔治大学国际政治学教授因德吉特·帕马尔（Inderjeet Parmar）认为，特朗普希望透过与另外两个大国领袖直接接触，塑造自己是不可或缺的协议促成者，并展示美国仍掌握国际主导权，即使会谈实际内容有限。 中国的考量则有所不同。美国智库史汀生中心（Stimson Center）中国项目主任孙韵指出，北京希望取得会谈带来的外交形象效益，却不愿承担额外成本。她说：“中国想要的是形象，而不是成本。” 特朗普预计这次访华将是他今年第三次与习近平会面。美中两国目前维持脆弱的贸易休战安排，协议预计于明年1月届满。中国今年主办APEC领导人非正式会议，成员包括美国及俄罗斯。 分析人士也关注，三方会谈可能令美国的欧洲及亚洲盟友被边缘化。帕马尔指出，二战后美国通常会先与盟友协调，再与俄罗斯或中国处理重大外交议题，若三国领袖绕过盟友直接讨论国际安全及经济安排，将反映美国外交模式出现转变。他说：“一场独立进行的三方会谈，可能将这些盟友视为次要角色，仿佛他们的利益可以在事后才处理。” 美国智库民主防卫基金会（Foundation for Defense of Democracies）中国项目高级主任克雷格·辛格尔顿（Craig Singleton）则认为，会谈可能最终只是一场让普京与美中领袖同框的拍照活动。他指出：“场面可能具有历史意义，却未必能产生任何特别重大的实际成果。”

title: (FRA獨家）特習會前北京醞釀五項貿易要求 涉關稅芯片及投資
summary: 特朗普與習近平計劃在APEC高峰會上進行今年第三次會唔。消息人士指出，中方醞釀提出五項貿易訴求，包括關稅、農產品採購、先進芯片及設備出口限制等。 (Julia Demaree Nikhinson/AP) 美國中期選舉之後，亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人非正式會議將於本月18日至19日在深圳舉行，美國總統特朗普預計與中國國家主席習近平在會議期間舉行今年第三次會面。 北京一位外貿部門人士向本臺透露，中方醞釀的五項貿易訴求涉及關稅、農產品採購、先進芯片及設備出口限制、中國企業赴美投
content: 特朗普與習近平計劃在APEC高峰會上進行今年第三次會唔。消息人士指出，中方醞釀提出五項貿易訴求，包括關稅、農產品採購、先進芯片及設備出口限制等。 (Julia Demaree Nikhinson/AP) 美國中期選舉之後，亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人非正式會議將於本月18日至19日在深圳舉行，美國總統特朗普預計與中國國家主席習近平在會議期間舉行今年第三次會面。 北京一位外貿部門人士向本臺透露，中方醞釀的五項貿易訴求涉及關稅、農產品採購、先進芯片及設備出口限制、中國企業赴美投資，以及跨境合規與多邊規則。其中，中方要求美方取消全部對華加徵關稅，落實農產品貿易便利化及關稅減讓安排，放寬先進芯片出口限制，併為中國企業赴美投資提供非歧視的營商環境。 北京擬要求取消對華加徵關稅 另一位不願公開身份和職務的人士說：“中方將要求美方徹底取消全部對華加徵關稅，還會提出以市場化原則積極擴大自美農產品進口，但前提是美方必須營造相應的貿易便利化條件，並切實給予關稅減讓。” 他還表示：“中方還要求美方停止對中國科技企業的無理打壓，停止將經貿科技問題泛安全化，並放寬相關先進芯片及設備的出口限制。” 上週四（5日），中國商務部發言人黃玲表示，中方對擴大采購美國農產品持開放態度，但前提是雙方達成的各涉及300億美元商品的對等降稅安排落實。她希望美方與中方共同降低關稅、減少非關稅壁壘及擴大市場準入。路透社報道，這項涉及雙方合計600億美元商品的降稅安排尚未最終落實。 中國外交部本週六發佈的消息顯示，中美經貿中方牽頭人、國務院副總理何立峰於本週五（6日）晚與美國財政部長貝森特、貿易代表格里爾舉行視頻通話，討論落實兩國元首北京和華盛頓會晤共識及經貿磋商成果。 另一位接近中國商務部的人士稱，中方正在考慮要求美方為中國電動車、電池及能源設備等企業赴美投資提供非歧視的營商環境。相關要求涉及中國企業在美國的市場準入、投資審查及經營條件。 習近平於2026年9月23日至25日對美國進行國事訪問期間，與特朗普就經貿問題達成多項共識，包括對雙方各約300億美元非敏感商品給予更優惠的關稅待遇，以及推進雙邊貿易和投資磋商機制。雙方還將此前達成的貿易休戰安排延長至2027年1月。相關關稅減讓措施尚未最終落實。 學者：中期選舉改變中美談判氣氛 研究中美關係的學者姚賦（化名）接受採訪時表示，在美國中期選舉改變美國政治格局之後，深圳APEC峰會期間的中美會晤氣氛也發生變化：“面對受到國會制約的特朗普，習肯定將利用特朗普剩下兩年執政，最大化習或中國的利益，包括貿易戰和臺灣問題等，並且以既定的所謂三巨頭峰會滿足特的虛榮心，製造其權力幻想。相信，習會趁機要求特在關稅、芯片等經貿問題上讓步，取消高關稅。” 姚賦進一步表示：“不過，是否達成合作成果仍然決定於特朗普本人能否說服習暫停對伊朗援助。畢竟關稅問題相比美伊戰爭，後者對特更為重要。目前局勢既有利於中方，看起來，習只要稍微在伊朗問題做出輕微讓步，便可從特朗普處大幅改善中美貿易關係和談判。” 資深評論人士蔡慎坤對本臺表示，美國中期選舉後，特朗普受到國會制約，北京可能調整對美談判策略。他說：“川普有可能不再堅持過去那麼強硬的貿易政策。因為他知道如果再堅持，中方會繼續的拖延，去年他們在釜山達成的協議現在已經不了了之，中國實際上一直在觀察，也在等待美國中期選舉。因為中期選舉川普輸了之後，很多制衡政策使得他很難發力了。” 談及臺灣問題，蔡慎坤錶示，北京希望特朗普在反對臺獨問題上作出表態，但美國兩黨在臺灣問題上的立場接近，特朗普讓步的空間有限。他認為，北京近期對臺灣採取軍事行動的可能性不大，2028年之後的政治變化可能影響臺海局勢。 對於中美俄三國領導人是否在深圳舉行會談，北京一位知情人士表示，中方目前對烏克蘭問題關注有限，更重視解決中美貿易摩擦及美國對臺軍售問題。他說：“今天已經8號了，還沒聽說特朗普、普京和習近平舉行三國元首會談已進入議事日程。” 伊朗問題成會談進展風向標 伊朗問題也是判斷中美高層會談能否取得進展的其中一個風向標。姚賦分析稱，北京在伊朗問題上的立場可能影響特朗普對華貿易談判的考慮。

title: 黄仁勋婚外情牵出间谍疑云：美中媒体如何讲述同一个故事？
summary: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安
content: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安全。 中国官方媒体则采取了明显不同的报道角度。它们提及黄仁勋的婚外情，但着重质疑有关中国间谍活动的说法，指责西方媒体借此炒作中国威胁论，甚至可能试图破坏美中关系。 美媒：从私人关系延伸到国家安全 美国《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》以及其他西方媒体的报道，将这起事件置于美国与中国围绕超级智能技术展开竞争的大背景下。 相关报道指出，与黄仁勋有关系的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)据称与一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业超速国际(Megaspeed International)有关联。这家公司涉及英伟达先进超级智能芯片的商业活动，因此引起美国方面的关注。 《纽约时报》报道说，美国情报部门怀疑黄乐可能与中国情报机构存在联系，并向北京提供过信息。不过，这些指控目前尚未通过公开的司法程序得到证实。 《华尔街日报》星期一(11月9日)以时间线方式，详细报道从与黄乐有关的Megaspeed于2023年从一家中国公司分拆成立开始，回顾黄仁勋与黄乐在2024年、2025年同场出现，以及美国商务部随后调查Megaspeed是否将英伟达先进芯片转运至中国。 报道还梳理了特朗普政府对英伟达对华出口政策的讨论，以及美国情报部门在2026年春季向政府高层传阅机密备忘录的说法。到了11月8日，黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠，英伟达董事会随即启动独立调查。 黄仁勋事件之所以引人关注，与英伟达在美国科技产业和国家安全领域的重要地位密切相关。 作为全球领先的超级智能芯片制造商，英伟达不仅是美国科技产业的重要企业，也处于华盛顿对华高科技出口管制政策争论的中心。 黄仁勋过去多次公开反对过度限制美国企业向中国市场销售先进芯片，认为过于严厉的出口限制可能削弱美国企业的竞争力，同时推动中国加快发展自己的半导体产业。 目前没有公开证据证明黄仁勋明知对方从事情报活动，也没有确凿证据表明英伟达的商业机密已经因此泄露。 中国官方媒体：质疑间谍指控，强调政治动机 中国官方媒体对这起事件的报道呈现出明显不同的侧重点，主要通过否认和质疑间谍指控，批评美国媒体的报道方式及其背后的政治动机。 中国官媒《环球时报》将事件与当前美中关系联系起来，质疑有关指控出现的时机，认为有关报道可能意在制造美中之间的对立。 《环球时报》星期一发布题为《黄仁勋出轨，还能扯上中国？》的快评，称这一事件“让美国媒体为之疯狂”，并批评《纽约时报》有关黄仁勋婚外情对象可能是中国间谍的报道捕风捉影。 《环球时报》写道：“仅仅是几张有东方面孔的照片、英伟达此前推动放宽对华贸易限制的行动，在其中加入了所谓“知情人士”的话和媒体的“怀疑”，就足以将事情添油加醋为“中国女间谍渗透美国芯片公司”。向来自诩“客观”的美国媒体正是这样生产故事的。” 环球之后说，在美中关系趋于缓和之际，出现此类新闻，是有些人“在背后放冷枪”。 这篇评论随后被凤凰网、新浪、网易、腾讯等多家中国媒体转载，使其观点在中国网络媒体上得到进一步传播。 与美国媒体相比，这些报道较少深入讨论美国情报部门提出的具体疑点，也没有将相关情报指控作为报道的主要调查方向。报道的重点更多放在质疑美国媒体的消息来源、证据基础以及报道动机上。 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期一在回应有关报道时，也否认中国从事相关间谍活动，称“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑。” 中国社交媒体：对婚外情的关注不亚于间谍疑云 中国社交媒体上的讨论则呈现出更加多元的面貌。 微博上，部分网民对黄仁勋的私人生活表示惊讶或失望。黄仁勋长期以来在中国科技界和商业界拥有较高知名度，不少中国公众将他视为华人科技企业家的代表人物。 在小红书上，除了讨论黄仁勋的婚外情及其可能涉及的间谍疑云，也有不少网友关注事件对英伟达股价的影响。 星期一早间，英伟达股价一度下跌超过8%，引发投资者讨论。有网友调侃说：“他犯的错，我买单。” 这些讨论显示，对不少中国网民来说，黄仁勋的私人生活、公众形象以及英伟达的市场表现，都是这起事件值得关注的方面。相比之下，间谍指控并非所有讨论的中心。

title: 英伟达股价再次下滑，CEO黄仁勋面临诉讼及FBI调查
summary: 在华盛顿美国和平研究所举行的一场活动中，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统发言时倾听。(2026年10月8日) 英伟达(Nvidia)股价星期二(11月10日)连续第二天走低，这家位于美国的半导体公司首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)同时面临股东诉讼，并承受着来自国会日益增长的压力。 此次抛售的前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)说，联邦调查局(FBI)正在调查黄仁勋与女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)之间的关系；美国情报部门认定，这
content: 在华盛顿美国和平研究所举行的一场活动中，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统发言时倾听。(2026年10月8日) 英伟达(Nvidia)股价星期二(11月10日)连续第二天走低，这家位于美国的半导体公司首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)同时面临股东诉讼，并承受着来自国会日益增长的压力。 此次抛售的前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)说，联邦调查局(FBI)正在调查黄仁勋与女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)之间的关系；美国情报部门认定，这名女商人是在为中国搜集情报。 英伟达董事会于星期日启动了独立审查，原因是有报道指黄仁勋成为外国情报机构的目标。黄仁勋在发给员工的一则信息中承认自己曾有不忠行为，但未透露女方身份。 特朗普与黄仁勋通话 英伟达股价在星期二上午交易时段下跌了5.3%。星期一收盘时，该股下跌了4.3%，导致公司市值缩水约1900亿美元。 特朗普在星期一的白宫简报会上说，他曾致电黄仁勋，询问其近况。 特朗普说，“我问了他那个问题：‘你知不知道她是间谍？’他说‘我完全不知道她是间谍。’我确实相信他，”“我知道联邦调查局正在调查此事，”“我认为他会没事的。” 特朗普将于下星期前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会，届时他预计将与中国国家主席习近平会晤。当被问及是否会向习提及此事时，特朗普说，“不，我想不会。我是说，也许吧。我相信习近平主席会问起这件事的。” 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期二在北京拒绝表明习近平是否会提出这一问题。他仅表示，双方正在就两国领导人今年的会晤安排进行讨论。中方已否认了有关间谍指控。 投资人诉讼 散户投资者马克·基斯滕马赫(Mark Kistenmacher)星期一在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的联邦法院对英伟达及黄仁勋提起诉讼；他在一份拟议的集体诉讼中指控他们欺骗了股东。根据起诉书，英伟达隐瞒了相关事宜，并对其与Megaspeed公司之间的往来情况进行了失实陈述；Megaspeed是一家位于新加坡的企业，黄乐曾在此担任高管。诉讼文件指称，此举使英伟达的声誉和业务面临“重大风险”。 原告要求由陪审团审理此案，并寻求损害赔偿，但未明确具体金额。诉讼涵盖10月9日至11月8日期间买入英伟达股票的股东。英伟达未立即就此诉讼置评。 议员们要求给出答复 众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯(Hakeem Jeffries)星期一说，“显然，国会需要更多信息。”杰弗里斯说。当天在中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫(John Ratcliffe)和国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿(Jay Clayton)参加的机密简报会上，伊朗问题占据了主导地位，英伟达只是被顺带提及。 马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)和印第安纳州共和党参议员吉姆·班克斯(Jim Banks)星期一在一份联合声明中说，这一事件使国家安全方面的担忧“变得更加紧迫”。他们敦促国会将《人工智能监管法案》(AI Overwatch Act)这个让国会能够监督最先进芯片出口的法案，纳入年度国防法案。 来自特拉瓦州的民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯(Chris Coons)在X上写道，他正在“推动对黄仁勋及英伟达展开调查，以确定我们的国家安全是否受到了损害。”

title: 从美国海军退伍军人到学区公共事务参与者：秦伟平积极参与Katy ISD社区教育，筹备2027年学区董事选举
summary: 美国德克萨斯州 Katy 消息（2026年11月10日） 美国海军退伍军人、联邦政府雇员秦伟平（Weiping Qin，又名 George Qin）近日持续参与美国德克萨斯州 Katy ISD (Katy Independent School District）当地学校及社区公共事务。11月9日，他先后参加孩子所在学校的家长教师协会（PTA）会议，以及 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，与家长、社区成员和学区董事进行交流，进一步了解当地教育事务。 秦伟平目前正筹备参加20
content: 美国德克萨斯州 Katy 消息（2026年11月10日） 美国海军退伍军人、联邦政府雇员秦伟平（Weiping Qin，又名 George Qin）近日持续参与美国德克萨斯州 Katy ISD (Katy Independent School District）当地学校及社区公共事务。11月9日，他先后参加孩子所在学校的家长教师协会（PTA）会议，以及 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，与家长、社区成员和学区董事进行交流，进一步了解当地教育事务。 秦伟平目前正筹备参加2027年5月举行的 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举，拟竞选 Board of Trustees, Position 6（学区董事会第6席位）。随着竞选准备工作的逐步推进，他开始更加积极地参与当地学校活动，并通过个人 X（原 Twitter）、Facebook 和 Substack 等平台分享对美国地方公共教育及社区治理的观察。 此次学校和学区活动，展现了他从一名学生家长参与学校事务，到进一步关注地方公共教育治理的个人经历。 一、参与学校PTA会议：计划组织中国文化活动 11月9日中午，秦伟平参加了孩子所在学校的 PTA 会议，与其他家长和学校社区成员讨论2027年2月 International Night（国际文化之夜）的活动安排。 秦伟平表示，他计划积极报名担任活动义工，协助协调、组织和宣传中国文化相关活动，让更多美国学生和家庭有机会了解中国传统文化。 他特别回忆了去年国际文化之夜上华裔孩子们表演的传统扇子舞。精彩的表演给现场观众留下了深刻印象，也让不同文化背景的家庭有机会通过艺术和传统文化相互了解。 秦伟平认为，国际文化之夜不仅是一次文化展示，更是学校促进多元文化交流、增进不同族裔家庭之间理解与尊重的重要平台。 Katy 社区拥有来自不同国家和文化背景的家庭。随着国际移民家庭不断融入当地社会，学校也成为不同文化相互交流的重要场所。 作为一名亚裔美国人和三个孩子的父亲，秦伟平希望通过实际参与学校活动，让更多家庭了解中国文化，同时也让华裔家长和孩子更加积极地融入美国当地社区。 他认为，学校不仅承担知识教育的责任，也应当成为培养孩子包容意识、文化理解能力和社区归属感的重要场所。 二、出席Katy ISD董事会特别会议，与现任及新当选董事交流 当天晚上，秦伟平又参加了 Katy ISD 学区董事会特别会议，并有机会与现任学区董事交流。 他特别提到，董事会主席 Lance Redmon，以及新当选董事 Cicely Taylor 主动上前与他打招呼。 令秦伟平感到意外和温暖的是，Cicely Taylor 直接称呼他为 George，并主动分享了自己的竞选经历，同时鼓励他积极参与学区董事选举。 秦伟平表示，这份友善和鼓励让他深受鼓舞，也让他感受到当地公共事务参与者之间开放、积极的交流氛围。 由于当晚还需要接送参加游泳培训课程的孩子，秦伟平未能在会议结束时与所有董事逐一交流。他希望未来能够有更多机会与学区董事、教育工作者和社区领袖建立联系，进一步了解学区面临的实际问题。 他表示，如果未来能够进入学区董事会，与其他董事共同为学生、家长、教师和社区服务，将是一份值得珍惜的公共服务责任。 需要指出的是，相关交流属于正常的社区接触和个人鼓励，并不意味着上述董事已经对其竞选作出正式背书。 三、从关注教师和特殊教育，到关注新移民学生的教育需求 事实上，秦伟平对 Katy ISD 教育事务的关注并非始于此次活动。 根据其此前在个人 X 账号发布的内容，他曾参加 Katy ISD Fall Conference，并与两位特殊教育教师交流，询问她们在日常工作中遇到的最大困难。 教师提到的师资短缺、人员流失，以及满足不同学生学习需求所面临的挑战，让秦伟平产生了进一步思考。 他在相关公开发文中提到，特殊教育涉及大量有阅读障碍、自闭症及其他学习和发展需求的学生。每一个学生背后，都有一个需要学校支持的家庭，以及一群承担教育责任的教师。 他认为，支持学生，就必须重视一线教师的工作条件和专业需求。学区在资源配置和预算管理方面，应当充分考虑教师队伍建设及特殊教育服务的实际需要。 此外，秦伟平也曾在 X 平台关注新移民学生的语言教育问题。 他指出，Katy ISD 有大量来自不同国家的移民家庭，许多学生在家中使用的第一语言并非英语。西班牙语、中文、越南语和阿拉伯语等语言，在当地多元文化社区中具有一定代表性。 他对学区 ESL（英语作为第二语言）项目给予肯定，同时也关注英语能力有限的新移民家长如何了解学校政策、与教师沟通，以及如何帮助孩子适应新的学习环境。 在另一则公开发文中，他特别表达了对部分新移民家庭教育信息获取困难的担忧，认为语言障碍不应该成为家长参与孩子教育的障碍。 这些观点表明，他关注的教育问题不仅包括学校整体教育质量，也包括特殊教育学生、新移民家庭以及不同文化背景学生能否获得适当的教育支持。 此前，纵览中国也曾根据秦伟平的公开发文，报道他对 Katy ISD 特殊教育、教师短缺和新移民学生教育问题的关注。 四、美国海军服役经历与联邦公共服务背景 秦伟平的个人经历具有一定的多元性。 他曾在美国海军服役，退役后继续从事美国联邦政府公共服务工作。同时，他拥有工商管理硕士（MBA）学位，目前正在攻读公共管理硕士（MPA）。 他认为，军旅经历使自己更加重视纪律、责任、团队合作和执行能力；联邦政府工作经历则让他对公共机构的行政管理、制度运行和公共服务有了更深入的认识。 作为三个 Katy ISD 学生的父亲，他也有机会从家长角度直接了解当地学校的日常运作，以及家庭对教育质量、校园安全和教师队伍的期待。 此前，他在公开讨论 Katy ISD 教育问题时，曾表示希望将自己在财务管理、预算监督、项目管理和资源配置方面的专业知识运用到未来的学区治理工作中。 他认为，学区董事会不仅需要关注教育政策，也需要认真履行公共财政监督责任，确保纳税人的教育资金能够有效用于学生成长和学校发展。 其竞选宣传中使用的英文口号为： “Served Our Country. Defending Our Classrooms.” 中文可译为： “曾为国家服役，如今守护我们的课堂。” 这一口号将他的军旅经历与对公共教育的关注联系起来，也构成了其个人竞选形象的重要组成部分。 五、正式推进竞选筹备，目标2027年5月学区董事选举 秦伟平目前正在为2027年5月 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举做准备，拟竞选 Position 6。 根据其此前提交的德克萨斯州竞选财务主管任命文件（Form CTA），他已经启动相关竞选申报程序，并按照现阶段要求提交了有关文件。 此后，他还提交了《公平竞选行为守则》（Code of Fair Campaign Practices）相关文件。 这些步骤标志着其竞选筹备从早期的个人意向和社区交流，逐步进入正式的行政申报和组织准备阶段。不过，相关文件提交并不等同于最终取得选票资格，后续仍须遵守适用的选举程序和申报要求。 在社交媒体方面，秦伟平持续通过个人 X 和 Facebook 发布与 Katy ISD 教育、社区活动和公共服务有关的内容，并开始使用 Substack 撰写较为完整的个人文章，介绍自己的经历、观察和教育理念。 他近期提出，希望进一步走访 Katy ISD 不同社区，与家长、教师和居民直接交流，了解他们对学区教育的期待与实际困难。 对于这场地方学区选举，他也认识到，学区董事会的公共职责涉及不同族裔、不同经济背景和不同文化传统的家庭，候选人需要倾听整个社区，而不能仅仅依靠某一个族裔群体的支持。 六、从家庭参与到公共治理：地方教育事务中的亚裔声音 美国学区董事会选举属于地方公共治理的重要组成部分。与联邦和州级选举不同，学区董事会的工作与居民家庭的日常生活联系十分密切。 学区预算、教师招聘与留任、特殊教育、校园安全、课程安排以及教育资源配置等事项，都可能直接影响当地学生和家庭。 对于人口结构多元、移民家庭较多的 Katy 社区而言，如何让不同背景的家长充分参与学校事务，如何在教育资源分配中兼顾不同学生的实际需求，也是地方教育治理需要面对的问题。 秦伟平的参选筹备，反映出一名亚裔美国居民希望从家庭和社区参与出发，进一步进入美国地方公共事务领域的尝试。 从参加 PTA 会议、准备参与中国文化活动，到出席学区董事会会议、与现任及新当选董事交流，再到通过社交媒体公开讨论特殊教育、新移民学生和教师队伍建设，他正在逐步建立与当地教育社区的联系。 秦伟平表示，自己作为三个 Katy ISD 孩子的父亲，深知优质公共教育离不开家长、教师、学校管理者和整个社区的共同努力。 如果能够在2027年5月的选举中当选，他希望把自己的专业经验、军旅背景和多元文化视角带入学区董事会，认真倾听不同群体的声音，为学生、家长和教师提供更加务实的服务。 他在最新发布的个人文章中写道： “教育不僅僅發生在課堂上，更體現在家庭的參與、不同文化之間的交流，以及我們為每一個孩子創造更好成長環境的共同努力之中。” 对于秦伟平而言，从曾经为国家服役，到今天作为一名父亲积极参与学校和社区事务，是其人生公共服务经历的延续。 2027年5月的 Katy ISD 学区董事会选举，将成为检验其社区动员能力、公共政策理念和选民支持度的一次重要机会。 他能否将目前的社区参与和个人影响力转化为更广泛的选民支持，仍有待未来竞选进程进一步观察。 相关人物： 秦伟平（Weiping Qin / George Qin） 竞选职位： Katy ISD Board of Trustees, Position 6 选举时间： 2027年5月 个人社交媒体： X（@WeipingQin）、Facebook、Substack 相关竞选信息： https://secure.anedot.com/weiping-qin-campaign/donate 关键词： 秦伟平、Katy ISD、美国地方教育、学区董事会、亚裔美国人、美国海军退伍军人、特殊教育、新移民教育、2027年选举 —— 纵览中国相关人物与美国地方公共事务观察

title: Update Chrome now to fix a flaw attackers are exploiting
zh_title: 立即更新 Chrome 以修复攻击者利用的漏洞
source: Malwarebytes实验室（恶意软件/间谍软件）
summary: 11 月 9 日，谷歌发布了适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的 Chrome 稳定频道的安全更新。该更新将在未来几天和几周内推出。大多数用户都使用 Chrome 的稳定渠道。此次桌面更新将 Chrome 带到了 Windows 和 Mac 版本 157.0.8103.50/.51 以及 Linux 版本 157.0.8103.50。它包括九个安全修复程序，其中一个针对被积极利用的零日漏洞。零日漏洞是在官方修复可用之前披露或利用的安全缺陷。香港计算机紧急应变小组协调中心（HKCERT）
content:
11 月 9 日，谷歌发布了适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的 Chrome 稳定频道的安全更新。该更新将在未来几天和几周内推出。大多数用户都使用 Chrome 的稳定渠道。此次桌面更新将 Chrome 带到了 Windows 和 Mac 版本 157.0.8103.50/.51 以及 Linux 版本 157.0.8103.50。它包括九个安全修复程序，其中一个针对被积极利用的零日漏洞。零日漏洞是在官方修复可用之前披露或利用的安全缺陷。香港计算机应急响应小组协调中心（HKCERT）将总体风险评级为“极高”。其公告称，更新中解决的一些漏洞可能允许拒绝服务、安全限制绕过和远程代码执行。如何更新 Chrome 最简单的选择是允许 Chrome 自动更新。但是，如果您从未关闭浏览器或出现问题（例如扩展程序阻止更新），您最终可能会落后于更新。如果您不想等待发布，您可以手动更新。从 Chrome 的“设置”或“帮助”菜单中打开“关于 Google Chrome”。 Chrome 将检查更新并下载任何可用的更新。如果出现提示，请单击“重新启动”以应用它。 Chrome 157.0.8103.51 已更新 您可以在我们的指南中找到版本编号系统的说明和分步说明：如何在每个操作系统上更新 Chrome 。
谷歌还于 11 月 9 日发布了 Android 版 Chrome 157.0.8103.50。谷歌表示，除非另有说明，否则它包含与桌面版本相同的安全修复程序。 Android 用户应检查 Google Play 是否有更新。技术细节让我们仔细看看这个零日漏洞。谷歌表示，它于 11 月 6 日收到未具名第三方的漏洞通知。该漏洞被追踪为 CVE-2026-125350，并被评为 Chrome XML 组件中的高严重性释放后使用漏洞。 XML 是 Chrome 用来读取和处理某些类型的结构化 Web 内容的数据格式。 XML 代表可扩展标记语言：它使用标签来标记信息，就像 HTML 一样，但允许作者定义自己的标签来描述他们的数据。当程序尝试访问已释放的内存位置时，就会发生释放后使用漏洞。这可能会导致崩溃，或者在某些情况下，允许攻击者运行自己的代码。谷歌仅表示“意识到 CVE-2026-125350 的漏洞存在”。它没有透露攻击者、目标、交付方法或该漏洞可以做什么。在威胁造成任何伤害之前阻止它们。 Malwarebytes Browser Guard 自动阻止网络钓鱼页面和恶意网站。免费，一键安装。将其添加到您的浏览器 →

【原文 English Original】
On November 9, Google issued a security update to Chrome’s Stable channel for Windows, Mac, and Linux. The update is rolling out over the coming days and weeks. Most users are on Chrome’s Stable channel. The desktop update brings Chrome to versions 157.0.8103.50/.51 for Windows and Mac and 157.0.8103.50 for Linux . It includes nine security fixes, including one for an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability. A zero-day vulnerability is a security flaw disclosed or exploited before an official fix becomes available. Hong Kong’s Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Centre (HKCERT) rates the overall risk as “Extremely High.” Its bulletin says some of the vulnerabilities address in the update could allow denial of service, security restriction bypass, and remote code execution. How to update Chrome The easiest option is to allow Chrome to update automatically. But you can end up lagging behind on updates if you never close your browser or if something goes wrong, such as an extension preventing the update. If you don’t want to wait for the rollout to reach you, you can update manually. Open About Google Chrome from Chrome’s Settings or Help menu. Chrome will check for updates and download any available update. If prompted, click Relaunch to apply it. Chrome 157.0.8103.51 is up to date You can find an explanation of the version numbering system and step-by-step instructions in our guide: How to update Chrome on every operating system . Google also released Chrome 157.0.8103.50 for Android on November 9. Google says it includes the same security fixes as the desktop release unless otherwise noted. Android users should check Google Play for the update. Technical details Let’s take a closer look at that zero-day vulnerability. Google says it was notified about a vulnerability by an unnamed third party on November 6. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-125350 and rated as a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome’s XML component. XML is a data format Chrome uses to read and process certain kinds of structured web content. XML stands for Extensible Markup Language: it labels information with tags, rather like HTML, but allows authors to define their own tags to describe their data. A use-after-free vulnerability occurs when a program attempts to access a memory location after it has been freed. That can cause crashes or, in some cases, allow an attacker to run their own code. Google only says that it is “aware that an exploit for CVE-2026-125350 exists in the wild.” It has not named the attackers, the targets, the delivery method, or what the exploit can do. title: Microsoft lobbies against potential ban on Chinese optical networking gear for AI data centers as FCC mulls restricting imports
zh_title: FCC 考虑限制进口，微软游说反对针对人工智能数据中心的中国光网络设备的潜在禁令
summary: 据报道，科技巨头微软正在美国各地建设 35 个数据中心，并计划再建设 134 个数据中心，据报道，微软已与白宫科学技术政策办公室和国家安全委员会会面，因为 FCC 正在考虑禁止进口中国光收发器。据路透社报道，该公司与信息技术产业委员会（ITI）一起游说反对此举。深入了解 TH Premium：人工智能和数据中心（图片来源：微软） 数据中心冷却现状 定制 AI ASIC 现状 美国的人工智能芯片规则不断变化
content:
据报道，科技巨头微软正在美国各地建设 35 个数据中心，并计划再建设 134 个数据中心，据报道，微软已与白宫科学技术政策办公室和国家安全委员会会面，因为 FCC 正在考虑禁止进口中国光收发器。据路透社报道，该公司与信息技术产业委员会（ITI）一起游说反对此举。深入了解 TH Premium：AI 和数据中心（图片来源：Microsoft） 数据中心冷却现状 定制 AI ASIC 现状 美国的 AI 芯片规则不断变化，而世界其他国家正在为此付出代价 GTC 2026：Ian Buck 新闻问答记录 — 超大规模和 HPC 副总裁就今年搁置 CPX 和运输 LPU 解码发表讲话 对数据中心 CPU 的需求激增，AI 代理对此负责“这确实威胁到了磨合” （数据中心的推出）暂停，”ITI 政策执行副总裁兼总法律顾问 John Miller 表示。他还补充道，“这些没有光学收发器的芯片实际上可能只是坐在那里等待未使用，直到你真正拥有收发器将它们基本上连接在一起”，他指的是数据中心使用的人工智能芯片。光收发器是插入硬件中的微型模块，可将电信号转换为光信号，从而允许数据以光脉冲的形式通过光纤传输。
数据中心越来越多地使用光收发器和光纤在 AI GPU 和服务器机架之间传输数据，因为与传统的铜连接相比，它们速度更快、延迟更低、功耗更低、产生的热量更少。然而，中国公司目前供应全球 66% 的市场，这意味着禁止他们向美国数据中心供货将使可用供应量减少一半以上，从而加剧一直困扰该行业的各种短缺问题。然而，有人担心其中一些收发器可能会被北京破坏，并被用来窃取数据、安装恶意软件或远程破坏美国数据中心，这就是 FCC 正在考虑实施限制的原因，就像它禁止华为进入美国电信网络一样。但与在电信硬件行业拥有众多老牌竞争对手的华为不同，只有两家美国公司生产数据中心所需的光收发器——相干公司和 Lumentum。虽然这些公司可以生产光收发器来与中国产品竞争，但如果联邦通信委员会今天禁止从中国进口，它们根本没有规模来弥补缺口。特朗普政府提出的一项妥协方案是，仅禁止能够达到每秒 3.2 兆比特的中国光收发器。虽然这项技术已经存在，但预计其生产要到 2028 年才会扩大，安装要到 2029 年才会开始。
这应该会让美国生产商有时间增加自己的产量，尽管该建议仍在考虑中。

【原文 English Original】
Microsoft, the tech giant that is building 35 data centers around the U.S. and has plans for 134 more, has reportedly met with the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy and the National Security Council as the FCC is considering an import ban on Chinese optical transceivers . According to Reuters , the company, alongside the Information Technology Industry Council (ITI), is lobbying against the move. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft) The data center cooling state of play The custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the price GTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this year Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible “It really threatens to arguably grind (the data center rollout) to a halt,” ITI Executive Vice President of Policy and General Counsel John Miller said. He also added, “Those chips, without optical transceivers, literally could just sit there waiting around unutilized until you actually have the transceivers to essentially connect them together,” referring to the AI chips that data centers use. Optical transceivers are tiny modules plugged into hardware that convert their electrical signals into light signals, allowing data to be transmitted as light pulses across fiber optics. Data centers increasingly use optical transceivers and fiber optics to transmit data between AI GPUs and server racks, as they’re faster, offer lower latency, require less power, and generate less heat compared to traditional copper connections. However, Chinese companies currently supply 66% of the global market, meaning banning them from supplying data centers in the U.S. would more than halve the available supply, thereby exacerbating the various shortages that have been pummeling the industry . However, there are concerns that some of these transceivers could be compromised by Beijing and be used to steal data, install malware, or remotely disrupt American data centers, which is why the FCC is considering the restriction, just like how it banned Huawei from the U.S. telecommunications network. But unlike Huawei, which had many established competitors in the telecommunications hardware industry, only two U.S.-based companies produce optical transceivers that data centers need — Coherent and Lumentum. While these firms could produce optical transceivers to compete with Chinese offerings, they simply do not have the scale to make up for the shortfall if the FCC bans Chinese imports today. One compromise floated by the Trump administration is that it would only ban Chinese optical transceivers capable of hitting 3.2 terabits per second. While this technology already exists, its production isn’t expected to expand until 2028, with installation not beginning until 2029. This should give American producers time to ramp up their own output, although the suggestion is still under consideration.

title: Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang
zh_title: 据报道，Alice Huang 在与 Jensen Huang 的三年合作关系中帮助确保了超过 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 进口
summary: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者也被怀疑是为中国国家安全部 (MSS) 工作的间谍。现在，The Information 的一项调查揭示了一个以上海世纪利通为中心、与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 有联系的公司“迷宫”，该公司此前被指控走私价值 20 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。该报告称，Alice Huang 帮助将 240,000 个被禁芯片运入该国，其中大部分是 H100 和 H200 系统，并在确保 AI GPU 进口到该国方面发挥了重要作用。
content:
Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者也被怀疑是为中国国家安全部 (MSS) 工作的间谍。现在，The Information 的一项调查揭示了一个以上海世纪利通为中心、与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 有联系的公司“迷宫”，该公司此前被指控走私价值 20 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。该报告称，Alice Huang 帮助将 24 万块被禁芯片运入该国，其中大部分是 H100 和 H200 系统，并在确保 AI GPU 进口方面发挥了重要作用，价值高达 75 亿美元。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制的解释 报告中的消息来源将这两家公司与 Alice Huang 联系起来他们的个人知识和公司注册记录，同时也有报道称Megaspeed购买的部分Nvidia AI芯片进入了上海世纪利通在中国的数据中心。但除了这些企业关系之外，还有大量关于她的报道。
黄女士与英伟达首席执行官的个人关系，以及这种关系如何使她能够采购其他地方很难获得的芯片。据称，黄仁勋公开吹嘘她与英伟达首席执行官的接触。熟悉她的人说，她经常将与詹森的照片上传到她的微信账户，甚至与顾客分享其他照片，以建立自己的可信度。她甚至声称，黄仁勋经常用晚餐和礼物来庆祝她的生日，而英伟达中国的一名销售员工则表示，她是该公司为中国当地合作伙伴举办的年度活动中的一张熟悉的面孔。据称，当人工智能的发货出现延误或遇到一些麻烦时，黄女士会介入，让它们重新通过供应链。另一位认识她的人士表示，她经常将自己与英伟达及其供应商的密切关系作为她总能获得英伟达人工智能芯片的原因。据估计，从 2023 年到 2025 年，价值 46 亿美元的人工智能芯片通过 Megaspeed 进口，另外 20 亿美元通过 Speedmatrix 进口。另据报道，上海世纪力通从其他渠道购买GPU，如果订单出现问题，则由Alice Huang协助，采购的GPU总价值估计约为75亿美元。报道称，黄女士帮助将约 24 万块违禁芯片转移到中国。 Alice Huang 出现在黄仁勋圈子里的时间可能比之前认为的要早得多。
一位消息人士告诉该刊物，爱丽丝·黄的丈夫康伟在 2010 年代认识了黄仁勋，当时英伟达主要是一家 PC 游戏 GPU 制造商。据报道，康伟当时是一位专注于视频游戏公司的私募股权投资者。相比之下，据报道黄女士在中国的两家媒体公司工作，尽管有人说没有她这样做的记录。她最终跳入银行和金融领域，先后在汇丰银行和中信证券工作，最终于 2023 年随着 Megaspeed 的转型和上海世纪利通的成立而进入数据中心行业。上海世纪利通数据中心

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang , who is also suspected of being a spy working for the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS). Now, an investigation by The Information has revealed a 'labyrinth' of companies centered around Shanghai Century Litong and connected to Singaporean firm Megaspeed, which has previously been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips. The report claims Alice Huang helped move 240,000 banned chips into the country, mostly H100 and H200 systems, and was instrumental in securing AI GPU imports to the tune of $7.5 billion. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Sources in the report link the two companies to Alice Huang via their personal knowledge and corporate registration records, while there have also been reports that some of the Nvidia AI chips Megaspeed bought went to Shanghai Century Litong’s data centers in China. But aside from these corporate ties, there were also numerous reports about Ms. Huang’s personal relationship with the Nvidia chief, and how it gave her the ability to procure chips that were otherwise hard to get elsewhere. Ms. Huang allegedly boasted about her access to the Nvidia CEO publicly. People familiar with her said that she regularly uploaded photos with Jensen to her WeChat account and even shared other images with customers to establish her credibility. She even claimed that Jensen Huang would often celebrate her birthday with dinner and gifts, while an Nvidia China sales employee said that she was a familiar face at the company’s annual event for local Chinese partners. When AI shipments hit delays or faced some trouble, Ms. Huang allegedly would step in to get them moving through the supply chain again. One other person who knows her said that she would often cite her close relationship with Nvidia and its suppliers as the reason why she could always get Nvidia AI chips. It’s estimated that $4.6 billion worth of AI chips have been imported through Megaspeed from 2023 to 2025, with another $2 billion routed through Speedmatrix. It was also reported that Shanghai Century Litong bought GPUs from other sources, with the assistance of Alice Huang if the orders faced an issue, with the total value of the GPUs acquired estimated to be around $7.5 billion. The report claims Ms. Huang helped move some 240,000 banned chips into China. Alice Huang may have appeared in Jensen Huang’s circle much earlier than previously believed. One source told the publication that Kang Wei, Alice Huang’s husband, met Jensen Huang during the 2010s, when Nvidia was primarily a PC gaming GPU manufacturer. According to the report , Kang Wei was a private equity investor focusing on videogame companies back then. In contrast, Ms. Huang reportedly worked for two media companies in China, although some say that there were no records of her doing so. She eventually jumped into banking and finance, working at HSBC and then CITIC Securities, before finally entering the data center industry in 2023 with Megaspeed’s pivot and the founding of Shanghai Century Litong. Shanghai Century Litong is a data center operator founded in June 2023 by a shareholder that was ultimately under the control of Huang Yu, the sister of Alice Huang, whose Chinese name is Huang Le. The company then provided compute capacity to AI tech giants in China, including Alibaba, Tencent, and other smaller labs. A few months after its founding, it received coveted Nvidia Preferred Cloud Partner status in October 2023, which is an important milestone as Nvidia requires anyone with this status to have demonstrated sufficient capability in handling and running Nvidia hardware as well as generating revenue at a certain level, although that threshold varies by region and partner type. In exchange for this, partners get better access to Nvidia’s limited number of chips, which became crucial for Shanghai Century Litong as the China-specific A800 and H800 chips were banned for sale to China around the same period. Although the move immediately banned the sales of these GPUs from Nvidia, it did not affect the chip stocks that were already in the hands of distributors. This meant that Shanghai Century Litong had priority access to the limited supply of these AI GPUs as Nvidia’s preferred partner. Megaspeed, on the other hand, was reportedly owned by a company called Huang Le Limited and led by Ms. Huang when it pivoted in 2023 and was subsequently sold to Singaporean entity Swiftdata soon after this. Megaspeed then set up a subsidiary called Speedmatrix, which has two offices in Johor, Malaysia, a couple of months after that. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), the U.S. agency in charge of monitoring export control compliance, noted that the Nvidia hardware found in Speedmatrix data centers was still in its boxes when they inspected the sites, triggering a deeper investigation into the company . Still, it’s been alleged that Nvidia intervened in the BIS probe , with the company retaining its Nvidia partner status to this day. Despite her public closeness with the Nvidia chief, she’s rather elusive when it comes to her personal information. Two other people said that she has always been vague about what she does at her companies, and that she’s careful when it comes to signing documents and leaving a paper trail that could easily be followed. Still, the Chinese embassy denies any links to Alice Huang, even as the FBI looks into the situation .

title: President Trump says the FBI is investigating Jensen Huang’s affair
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示联邦调查局正在调查黄仁勋的婚外情

【原文 English Original】
As more information about the ongoing situation at Nvidia unravels, U.S. President Donald Trump has confirmed that the FBI is investigating CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy days after he admitted to the indiscretion. According to the Associated Press , the president said this during a briefing at the White House, with one reporter asking him about his knowledge of Huang’s issue before it became publicly known. The news comes amidst a separate bombshell report from Bloomberg , which claims that Nvidia intervened in a US government probe of suspected chip smuggling by Megaspeed, where Alice Huang was an executive. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained “Well, I’ve been hearing about it, and I’ve been reading about it over a period of time, but, uh, not too long ago,” Trump said. “We’ll look into, I know the FBI is looking into it in terms of something, and I think he’ll be in good shape.” He also said, “I did speak to him today just to see if he’s feeling alright, how you’re doing. He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy.” It has been previously reported that U.S. intelligence services suspected that Alice Huang , who previously held an executive position at Megaspeed, had ties to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS), which is one of the country’s intelligence services, and that they told the President about it over a year ago. However, it was reported he did not act on the information, as he reportedly did not want to jeopardize Nvidia sales or antagonize Beijing, especially after the White House approved the export of H200 chips to China with an attached 25% fee. Congress has called Huang once to confront him about these rumors, with the CEO confirming his affair with Alice Huang shortly after. The committee said it has "concerns over Nvidia’s security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and Mr. Huang’s reported ties to a Chinese intelligence-linked executive of a Singapore-based data center company.” Now, it seems that the FBI, which is the U.S.’s primary domestic counterintelligence agency, is looking into the situation, too. While the infidelity of tech executives is usually outside the purview of politicians and law enforcement, Jensen Huang’s sensitive position as the head of the leading AI chip manufacturer that arguably single-handedly drove the global AI race has made him a prominent target. China has denied the accusation that Alice Huang is its agent, but a think tank suggests that “China is employing ‘attractive women’ posing as investors, business professionals, academics, or romantic partners to gain access to U.S. tech talent, networks, and research infrastructure.” This is why Nvidia’s supposed intervention in the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security’s (BIS) investigation into Megaspeed is becoming a concern. Megaspeed has been investigated for allegedly smuggling $2 billion worth of Nvidia AI processors into China , although Nvidia has claimed that it has done its due diligence and did not find any signs of diversions by the company. Despite that, Bloomberg reports that Nvidia executive vice president and general counsel Tim Teter reached out to U.S. Under Secretary of Commerce for Industry and Security and BIS head Jeffrey Kessler to ask about the administration’s investigation into the company and whether the BIS was involved in Singapore’s detention of Alice Huang at that time. Sources claimed that the U.S. agency was not involved in Ms. Huang’s apprehension by Singaporean authorities. The publication reported BIS staff were told to route all Nvidia requests through Kessler or to seek approval from him for any outreach involving the company, which people say was highly unusual, and that Teter even supposedly reached out directly to BIS employees. When the affected employees forwarded the emails to Kessler and raised their concerns, the BIS chief instructed them to handle the case by the book. But in late 2025, the Justice Department, which was working alongside the BIS, asked the bureau to pause its efforts on the Megaspeed investigation. Even though Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with Alice Huang, who was linked to Megaspeed and is suspected to be working at the behest of Beijing, there is still no clear proof that Ms. Huang had a direct role in influencing the Nvidia chief to push for the resumption of Nvidia AI chip sales to China. Still, the unraveling of this supposed spy plot has caught the attention of the American leadership, and they’re now asking questions about Nvidia’s security protocols and the company’s sway on Washington.

title: Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining
zh_title: 施耐德电气探索采矿业技术融合
summary: 施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；以及应用程序、分析和服务：
content:
施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；应用程序、分析和服务：人工智能驱动的见解支持协作、明智的行动和企业价值。施耐德电气利用其技术组合将来自设备、边缘和分析层的过程和能源数据与采矿专业知识和生态系统集成相结合。这支持整个采矿作业生命周期（从设计和施工到运营和维护）的数字孪生。 Torngat Metals：综合稀土合作伙伴 Torngat Metals 在开发加拿大 Strange Lake 稀土项目时，正在利用这些专业知识和集成能力。两家公司签署了一份不具约束力的谅解备忘录（MoU），以探索战略工业合作伙伴关系，支持弹性和负责任的稀土价值链。
拟议的合作伙伴关系以努纳维克的奇异湖、拉布拉多的相关基础设施以及计划中的九岛分离设施为中心。它将通过端到端的合作，将上游资源开发、技术集成和未来工业需求联系起来。该谅解备忘录概述了潜在的 360° 合作伙伴关系，有两个目标： 支持项目开发：将施耐德电气在电气化、自动化、数字系统和可持续工业设计方面的专业知识应用于下一代采矿和加工项目；增强供应链弹性：改善施耐德电气长期获得安全、负责任和合规的稀土和磁体生态系统的战略应用。奇湖预计将生产可再生能源、数字基础设施和先进制造中使用的永磁体所必需的重稀土元素和轻稀土元素。施耐德电气表示，拟议的合作超出了项目支持的范围：它代表着迈向值得信赖的端到端关键矿产价值链的一步。
Torngat 计划在 Strange Lake 整合一座矿山、季节性通道和港口，以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂（照片来源：Torngat Metals） 调整项目交付和未来需求 施耐德电气全球采矿、矿物和金属主管 Vivek Kapoor 表示，此类安排在战略意图上与早期承购关系类似。施耐德的同行通常会承担责任，同时激励两家公司实现项目 KPI。 “通过在如此早期阶段参与并探索未来工业需求如何支持该项目，我们对其长期成功进行了投资，”他上个月在伦敦举行的《金融时报》金属与矿业峰会间隙告诉 IM。 Torngat 计划将一座矿山、季节性通道和港口以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂整合在一起。施耐德电气表示，它在支持这一国际化所需的四个领域拥有经验。

【原文 English Original】
Schneider Electric says it is bringing together electrification, automation and digital intelligence to help mines operate as AI-powered, software-defined platforms that connect energy and industrial intelligence. AI across three connected layers The company describes three layers through which it helps mining companies apply AI: Connected devices: Intelligent devices sense operating conditions and provide data and control capabilities; Edge control and computing: Simulation and automation use AI to support flexible, efficient and resilient system performance; and Apps, analytics and services: AI-driven insights support collaboration, informed action and enterprise value. Schneider Electric uses its portfolio of technologies to combine process and energy data from the device, edge and analytics layers with mining expertise and ecosystem integration. This supports digital twins throughout the mining operations lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance. Torngat Metals: an integrated rare earth partnership Torngat Metals is drawing on these expertise and integration capabilities as it develops the Strange Lake rare earth project in Canada. The companies have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore a strategic industrial partnership supporting a resilient and responsible rare earth value chain. The proposed partnership centres on Strange Lake in Nunavik, associated infrastructure in Labrador and a planned separation facility in Sept-Îles. It would connect upstream resource development, technology integration and future industrial demand through an end-to-end collaboration. The MoU outlines a potential 360° partnership with two objectives: Support project development: Apply Schneider Electric’s expertise in electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design to a next-generation mining and processing project; and Strengthen supply chain resilience: Improve Schneider Electric’s long-term access to a secure, responsible and compliant rare earth and magnet ecosystem for strategic applications. Strange Lake is expected to produce heavy and light rare earth elements essential to permanent magnets used in renewable energy, digital infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Schneider Electric says the proposed collaboration goes beyond project support: it represents a step towards a trusted, end-to-end critical minerals value chain.   Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths at Strange Lake (photo credit: Torngat Metals) Aligning project delivery and future demand Vivek Kapoor, Schneider Electric’s Global Lead for Mining, Minerals & Metals, said arrangements of this kind are similar in strategic intent to an early-stage offtake relationship. He described them as going beyond what Schneider’s peers typically undertake, while giving both companies an incentive to deliver on project KPIs. “By engaging at such an early stage and exploring how future industrial demand could support the project, we are invested in its long-term success,” he told IM on the sidelines of the FT Metals & Mining Summit in London last month. Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths. Schneider Electric says it has experience across the four areas needed to support that integrated approach: electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design. Engineering and operational applications Connecting engineering and operations Through AVEVA engineering solutions, the CONNECT data services platform, AVEVA PI System and its advanced analytics ecosystem, Schneider Electric says it helps organisations unify operational technology, information technology and engineering technology data. This enables these organisations to apply AI-driven insights and put those insights into practice in near real time. AVEVA’s agentic AI capabilities, built into its unified engineering software solution, are already helping mining companies and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firms improve detailed engineering productivity, the company says. These capabilities automate repetitive tasks and comparisons, helping teams develop and optimise 3D models more efficiently. SQM: process optimisation At SQM’s operations, Kapoor says AI-powered predictive and optimisation models delivered: A 10-15% reduction in process variability; An increase in nitrate yield of up to 1%; and A 1-3% improvement in raw material efficiency. These improvements translate into higher productivity, less waste and improved sustainability. Roy Hill: a remotely connected pit-to-port operation Kapoor also highlighted Schneider Electric’s earlier work at the 55 Mt/y Roy Hill iron ore project in Western Australia. The company delivered remote operations and demand chain planning capabilities, integrating mine, plant, rail and port operations into a single remotely controlled ecosystem. These capabilities supported one of the industry’s most advanced greenfield deployments and helped optimise the journey from resource to market. “This really was a pit-to-port project for Roy HIll,” he said. For lead EPC provider Samsung C&T, Schneider Electric delivered the port facility’s complete power infrastructure, including 14 switch rooms, transformers, drives, backup power, cooling and power management systems. Image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) Vale: centralised monitoring Schneider Electric and AVEVA, which Schneider Electric owns, have also worked with Vale in Brazil to integrate, centralise and remotely monitor operations across its Mariana and Itabira complexes. Schneider Electric says it is also applying hybrid advanced process control and AI to improve milling-circuit performance. In other industrial applications, these solutions have reduced furnace NOx emissions. Removing data silos and putting insights to work A shared data backbone Schneider Electric sees its ability to unify siloed operational data within a scalable, enterprise-ready architecture as a key market differentiator. That capability is also important to Torngat Metals’ integrated project approach. In traditional mining and processing environments, data from sensors, control systems and laboratories often sits in disconnected systems, limiting its usefulness, the company says. Schneider Electric says CONNECT provides a centralised data backbone on top of AVEVA PI System, enabling secure, near-real-time sharing between on-premises systems and cloud analytics platforms. At SQM, for example, operational data is made accessible in Databricks through Delta Sharing. This supports advanced AI, machine-learning and simulation workflows with near-real-time refresh cycles, according to Schneider Electric. “This architecture eliminates data silos and provides an open, developer-friendly environment for building and scaling AI solutions – an essential foundation for industrial transformation,” the company says. From recommendations to operational action Schneider Electric describes a “closed-loop approach” in which model outputs are fed back into operational systems, rather than remaining separate analytical insights. At SQM, predictive and optimisation models generate real-time recommendations for feed ratios, temperatures and flows. Schneider Electric says these outputs are written back into CONNECT and displayed in operator tools such as AVEVA PI Vision. Operators can then compare actual performance with AI-driven optimal conditions and act on the recommendations. Prescriptive setpoint optimisation similarly allows AI models to recommend and guide operational adjustments. In some cases, these adjustments can run automatically to support continuous performance improvement. “This integration transforms AI from a decision-support tool into an active driver of operational performance,” it says. Adapting AI models and scaling deployment Continuous model development Schneider Electric says its architecture supports rapid development and deployment of machine-learning models, hybrid simulation models and dynamic optimisation algorithms. In practice, this includes: Training and retraining machine-learning models using the large volumes of data held in AVEVA PI System, which is widely adopted at mining sites; Developing hybrid models that combine physics-based simulations with data-driven AI; and Running real-time scenario simulations to optimise production conditions. At SQM, Schneider Electric says predictive models achieved approximately 90% accuracy, increasing operator confidence and improving decision quality. Model retraining cycles were also significantly reduced, enabling faster adaptation to changing process conditions and continuous performance improvement. From individual use cases to enterprise-wide deployment Scalability is another key differentiator, according to Schneider Electric. The company says its architecture supports deployment across multiple plants, processes and business units, rather than being limited to individual use cases. At SQM, the success of nitrate optimisation has led to plans to expand into additional plants and incorporate richer datasets, including maintenance and laboratory analytics, the company claims. Schneider Electric presents this as an example of the progression from pilot projects to broader digital transformation. Looking ahead: an integrated mine-to-metal benchmark The MoU between Schneider Electric and Torngat Metals points towards a similarly integrated approach. Schneider Electric hopes the proposed mine-to-metal collaboration will establish a benchmark for digital transformation across Torngat’s operations. “By embedding sustainability, efficiency and digital performance across the project lifecycle, from design through operations, the partnership aims to set new standards for responsible resource development,” it says. Lead image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) The post Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining appeared first on International Mining .

title: Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged spy is powering a new class of realistic meme that Nvidia made possible
zh_title: 黄仁勋与一名所谓间谍的恋情正在推动英伟达打造的一类新型现实模因成为可能
summary: 围绕黄仁勋与一名所谓间谍的婚外情的丑闻已经逃离了硅谷的沙盒，并在社交媒体上传播开来。但在互联网的一个特别奇怪的角落，受这件事启发的电影世界正在催生人工智能生成的音乐视频和由 Nvidia 首席执行官主演的短片。这起高风险的丑闻就像电影里的情节一样。此后，黄承认与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄有关系，黄爱丽是中国政府的间谍嫌疑人，可能会泄露一家公司内部的敏感信息，该公司的
content:
围绕黄仁勋与一名所谓间谍的婚外情的丑闻已经逃离了硅谷的沙盒，并在社交媒体上传播开来。但在互联网的一个特别奇怪的角落，受这件事启发的电影世界正在催生人工智能生成的音乐视频和由 Nvidia 首席执行官主演的短片。这起高风险的丑闻就像电影里的情节一样。此后，黄承认与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）有关系，黄爱丽被怀疑是中国政府的间谍，可能会泄露一家公司内部的敏感信息，该公司的技术正在推动人工智能的繁荣。 （尽管他们的姓氏不同，但两人并无关联。）自消息披露以来，Nvidia 的股价受到了打击，在持续的审查中市值损失了近 7000 亿美元。这家半导体巨头已对黄和间谍指控展开调查。由人工智能驱动的电影宇宙与此同时，社交媒体上的创作者正在采取不同的方法来应对这种情况，让黄、他的妻子和爱丽丝黄成为受流行文化启发的超现实人工智能生成视频的明星——所有这些都未经他们的同意。在发布到 X 的一段视频中，黄唱了 Shaggy 的 Wasn’t Me 。
他并不孤单：杰夫·贝索斯、理查德·布兰森和埃隆·马斯克等其他科技领袖也加入了黄仁勋的人工智能音乐视频，高喊着那句著名的台词“不是我”。在另一则视频中，黄与爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 一起重演了火爆的 ROSÉ 和 Bruno Mars APT 音乐视频，以粉红色背景为背景，伴随着夸张的歌声。在人工智能重现的 Drake 的 Hotline Bling 音乐视频和 George Michael 的 Careless Whisper 中也可以看到两人的身影。詹森和他的两位女士🤣🤣💀💀 pic.twitter.com/phAvywMDnk — The SI Maximalist (@thesimaximalist) 2026 年 11 月 10 日另一部影片中，黄仁勋和女商人出现在浪漫喜剧《与夏日的五百天》中因约瑟夫·高登-莱维特和佐伊·丹斯切尔而闻名的电梯场景，或者《天堂三步台阶》中广为人知的俱乐部场景。 Nvidia 自己的技术为您带来这种趋势的讽刺是很难逃避的。生成如此详细的真人视频只能归功于黄仁勋帮助创建和扩展的技术——Nvidia 强大的 GPU。 “无论是使用云工具还是在自己的机器上运行模型，繁重的工作通常都是由 Nvidia GPU 完成的，因为大多数人工智能软件都是在硬件上运行的，”人工智能身份验证公司 Incode Technologies 的首席执行官 Ricardo Amper 告诉 Fast Company。
通常，这些视频是使用 Nvidia 技术制作的，甚至是无意中制作的。“大多数制作 AI 视频的人从不接触 GPU。他们打开浏览器，输入提示或上传照片，”AI 制作工作室 Cuz 的联合创始人 Michael Bismuth 说。对于一些创作者来说，对黄间谍丑闻内容的突然需求甚至成为了宣传自己的人工智能产品的平台，比如一位联合创始人就受该事件的启发创作了一部微剧。 AI微剧制作平台PlotParty创始人邢索菲发布了一部用该软件制作的微剧，典型的俗套剧本，复仇拱门，以及过于冗长的描述性标题：我离婚了亿万富翁，计算之神让我重生在19岁。如果没有这家公司，这一切都不可能实现

【原文 English Original】
The scandal surrounding Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged spy has escaped the sandbox of Silicon Valley and spread across social media. But in one particularly bizarre corner of the internet, a cinematic universe inspired by the affair is spawning AI -generated music videos and short films starring the Nvidia CEO. The high-stakes scandal like something straight out of a movie. Huang has since admitted to a relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who is a suspected spy for the Chinese government—potentially compromising sensitive information inside a company whose technology is powering the AI boom. (Despite their surnames, the two are unrelated.) Nvidia’s stock has taken a hit since the reveal, losing nearly $700 billion in market value amid ongoing scrutiny. The semiconductor giant has opened an investigation into Huang and the spying allegations. A cinematic universe powered by AI Meanwhile, creators on social media are taking a different approach to the situation, making Huang, his wife, and Alice Huang the stars of hyper-realistic AI-generated videos inspired by pop culture—all without their consent. In one video posted to X , Huang sings Shaggy’s Wasn’t Me . He wasn’t alone: Other tech leaders like Jeff Bezos, Richard Branson, and Elon Musk join Huang in the AI music video, belting the famous lines “wasn’t me.” In another, Huang is joined by Alice Huang, reenacting the viral ROSÉ and Bruno Mars APT music video, set against a pink background with exaggerated singing. The two can also be spotted on an AI recreation of Drake’s Hotline Bling music video and George Michael’s Careless Whisper . Jensen and his two ladies 🤣🤣💀💀 pic.twitter.com/phAvywMDnk — The SI Maximalist (@thesimaximalist) November 10, 2026 Others inserted Huang into popular movie scenes, like one video reimagining the viral “why would I deceive you” exchange between Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes in You Can See Everything . Another sets Huang and the businesswoman in the elevator scene made famous by Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel in the romcom ( 500) Days of Summer , or the viral club scene from Three Steps Above Heaven . Brought to you by … Nvidia’s own tech The irony of the trend is hard to escape. Generating such detailed videos of real people is only possible thanks to the technology that Huang has helped create and scale—Nvidia’s powerful GPUs. “Whether someone uses a cloud tool or runs a model on their own machine, the heavy lifting is usually completed by Nvidia GPUs, simply because that’s the hardware that most AI software is built to run on,” Ricardo Amper, CEO of AI identity verification company Incode Technologies, tells Fast Company . And oten, these videos are made using the Nvidia technology, even inadvertently. “Most people making AI videos never touch a GPU. They open a browser, type a prompt or upload a photo,” says Michael Bismuth, cofounder of AI-production studio Cuz. For some creators, the sudden demand for Huang Spy Scandal content has even become a platform to advertise their own AI products, like one cofounder who created a microdrama inspired by the affair. Sophia Xing, founder of AI microdrama production platform PlotParty, posted a microdrama made with the software, with the quintessential clichéd script, a revenge arch, and an overly long and descriptive title: I Divorced My Trillionaire Husband and the God of Compute Let Me Respawn at 19 . None of it would be possible with out the company at the heart of the scandal. “Nvidia’s chips are the engine behind almost every fake video on the internet,” Bismuth says. “The company that made AI video possible is now one of its targets.”

title: The Jensen Huang scandal could become a legal nightmare for Nvidia
zh_title: 黄仁勋丑闻可能成为英伟达的法律噩梦
summary: 英伟达的麻烦可能才刚刚开始。除了股市损失和巨大的声誉受损之外，首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情也让这家芯片制造巨头面临重大法律风险。斯坦福大学法学教授罗伯特·巴特利特 (Robert Bartlett) 告诉 TechCrunch，最明确的指控是证券欺诈，这取决于该公司是否通过提供虚假或不完整的关系信息来欺骗投资者。这个角度已经导致了至少一项集体诉讼，其中引用了 Nvidia 发言人 John Rizzo 在 10 月底的声明，声称
content:
英伟达的麻烦可能才刚刚开始。除了股市损失和巨大的声誉受损之外，首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情也让这家芯片制造巨头面临重大法律风险。斯坦福大学法学教授罗伯特·巴特利特 (Robert Bartlett) 告诉 TechCrunch，最明确的指控是证券欺诈，这取决于该公司是否通过提供虚假或不完整的关系信息来欺骗投资者。这种角度已经引发了至少一项集体诉讼，其中引用了 Nvidia 发言人约翰·里佐 (John Rizzo) 10 月底的声明，称黄与所谓的间谍爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的互动“并不罕见或意外”。它还引用了黄仁勋本人随后的评论，即英伟达与爱丽丝·黄的雇主、新加坡的 Megaspeed 的关系“正常且并不罕见”，以及黄仁勋在 2025 年 5 月的评论称英伟达“没有发现其芯片被转移的证据”。至少前两种说法已被证明是不准确的。巴特利特告诉 TechCrunch，里佐的评论“显然是一个误导性的陈述”，并补充说，由于黄仁勋是 Nvidia 的首席执行官，法院将认为他的个人知识就是该公司的知识。巴特利特表示，除了证券欺诈责任外，该公司还可能面临治理责任。
即使最初不知道这个问题，一旦《纽约时报》开始报道该公司与 Megaspeed 的关系，Nvidia 董事会就应该被告知并采取行动。相反，董事会直到文章发表 10 天后才宣布展开调查。然而，最具爆炸性的法律场景是，如果黄以某种方式知道爱丽丝·黄的情报联系。福特汉姆法学院教授托马斯·李今天写道，这可能会让黄根据《经济间谍法》承担刑事责任，该法惩罚盗窃或盗用商业秘密以使外国政府受益的行为。 Lee补充说，黄还可能受到2018年《出口管制改革法》和《出口管理条例》的影响，该条例将把任何故意向黄爱丽转让技术或源代码的行为视为对中国的出口。英伟达董事会表示，没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露。唐纳德·特朗普总统昨天表示，黄告诉他，他不知道爱丽丝·黄是间谍。据彭博社报道，三位众议院委员会主席已要求黄仁勋下周举行闭门简报会。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s troubles may be just beginning. Along with stock market losses and massive reputational damage, CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy exposes the chipmaking giant to major legal risks. The most clear-cut claim is for securities fraud, Stanford Law professor Robert Bartlett told TechCrunch , which would rest on whether the company duped investors by providing false or incomplete information about the relationship. This angle has already led to at least one class action filing , which cites Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo’s statement in late October claiming Huang’s interactions with alleged spy Alice Huang were “ not unusual or unexpected .” It also cites a subsequent comment by Huang himself that Nvidia’s ties to Alice Huang’s employer, Singapore-based Megaspeed, were “ normal and not unusual ,” and Huang’s May 2025 comment that Nvidia had found “no evidence of diversion” of its chips.   At least the first two statements have since proven to be inaccurate. Rizzo’s comment was “clearly a misleading statement,” Bartlett told TechCrunch , adding that because Huang is Nvidia’s CEO, the court will consider his personal knowledge to be the company’s knowledge. Along with liability for securities fraud, the company could also be exposed to governance liability, Bartlett said. Even if it initially had no knowledge of the issue, Nvidia’s board should have been informed—and acted—once the New York Times began reporting on the company’s ties to Megaspeed. Instead, the board did not announce an investigation until 10 days after the article was published . However, the most explosive legal scenario would be if Huang somehow knew about Alice Huang’s intelligence connection.  Fordham School of Law Professor Thomas Lee wrote today that this could expose Huang to criminal liability under the Economic Espionage Act, which punishes theft or misappropriation of trade secrets to benefit a foreign government. Huang may also be exposed under the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 and the Export Administration Regulations, Lee added, which would consider any willful transfer of technology or source code to Alice Huang as an export to China. Nvidia’s board has said it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised. President Donald Trump said yesterday that Huang told him that he didn’t know Alice Huang was a spy. Three House committee chairs have asked Jensen Huang for a closed-door briefing next week, Bloomberg has reported .

title: The Iran War led to a decline in carbon emissions in 2026. It doesn’t mean we’ve turned a corner on fossil fuels
zh_title: 伊朗战争导致 2026 年碳排放量下降。这并不意味着我们已经摆脱了化石燃料的困境
summary: 随着伊朗战争提高了全球石油价格，石油排放量下降，太阳能和风能发电规模扩大。这导致 2026 年全球温室气体排放量略有下降。专家警告说，但这并不表明我们已经扭转了化石燃料使用的趋势。根据在土耳其主办的 COP31 气候谈判上提交并发表在《自然》杂志上的一份报告，预计到 2026 年，全球化石燃料碳排放量将减少 0.4%。这一变化是由于石油排放量下降所致，比上年减少约 1.9%。随着天然气和柴油的发展，石油排放量下降
content:
随着伊朗战争提高了全球石油价格，石油排放量下降，太阳能和风能发电规模扩大。这导致 2026 年全球温室气体排放量略有下降。专家警告说，但这并不表明我们已经扭转了化石燃料使用的趋势。根据在土耳其主办的 COP31 气候谈判上提交并发表在《自然》杂志上的一份报告，预计到 2026 年，全球化石燃料碳排放量将减少 0.4%。这一变化是由于石油排放量下降所致，比上年减少约 1.9%。研究人员指出，与 2025 年相比，美国、中国和欧盟的汽油和柴油泵价格上涨 10% 至 50%，石油排放量下降。但他们写道，全球排放量的这种变化“并不表明排放量已因向清洁能源过渡而达到峰值”。换句话说，全球范围内还没有从化石燃料转向可再生能源。卫星图像显示，胡塞武装从也门发动协调一致的袭击后，沙特阿拉伯国家石油公司位于沙特阿拉伯吉赞/吉赞的炼油厂和石油码头升起浓烟。这些袭击扰乱了红海曼德海峡的燃料出口，标志着也门战争中伊朗与沙特冲突的重大升级。拍摄于 2026 年 7 月 26 日。
[照片：Gallo Images/Orbital Horizo​​n/Copernicus Sentinel Data 2026/Getty Images] 相反，这种下降是对高油价和伊朗战争造成的供应链障碍的短期反应。这意味着我们在扩大清洁能源和阻止导致植物变暖的温室气体排放激增方面还有更多工作要做。埃克塞特大学全球碳预算办公室主任、该研究的负责人皮埃尔·弗里德林斯坦在一份声明中表示：“化石二氧化碳排放量的下降令人鼓舞，但部分由地缘政治冲击推动的减排并不是可持续的气候解决方案。”这种情况反映了 COVID-19 大流行第一年之后发生的情况，当时通勤停止和企业关闭的封锁导致碳排放量创纪录下降。这种下降的发生并不是因为推行智能气候政策，而是因为一件破坏稳定的事件。当时没有迹象表明排放量的下降会逐年持续，而这是减少排放量足以实现气候目标所需的。伊朗战争的影响带来了同样的威胁：一旦油价下跌且供应链问题得到解决，世界将恢复化石燃料业务一切如常的行为。气候分析公司首席执行官比尔·黑尔甚至不认为排放量的这种变化是下降。
他在一份声明中表示，这是一条“持平线”，0.4% 的下降“在统计上与零没有什么区别”。他补充道：“清洁能源转型正在带来真正的收益：太阳能、风能和电动汽车现在抵消了能源需求增长带来的约三分之二的排放增长。但这些收益正在被其他地方持续增长的化石燃料使用所吞噬：在工业、新兴经济体以及能源转型刚刚开始的各个行业。”化石燃料的危险一直是 COP31 气候谈判的一个主要话题。联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔在开幕致辞中表示，化石燃料价格高企的危机正在“像癌症一样蔓延通货膨胀”。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯也发表了类似评论，指出化石燃料不仅推动气候变化

【原文 English Original】
As the war in Iran raised global oil prices, oil emissions dropped and solar and wind power expanded.  That led to a slight decrease in global greenhouse gas emissions in 2026. But it’s not a sign that we’ve turned the tide on fossil fuel use, experts warn. Global carbon emissions from fossil fuels are projected to decrease by 0.4% in 2026, according to a report presented at the COP31 climate talks hosted in Turkey and published in the journal Nature . That change was driven by a drop in oil emissions, which will be about 1.9% less than the year prior.  Oil emissions declined as gas and diesel pump prices rose 10% to 50% across the United States, China, and the European Union, compared to 2025, the researchers note.  But this change in global emissions is “not a sign that emissions have peaked from the transition to cleaner energy,” they write. In other words, there hasn’t been a global turn away from fossil fuels and toward renewables. A satellite view of smoke plumes rising from Saudi Aramco’s refinery complex and oil terminals in Jazan/Jizan, Saudi Arabia, after coordinated Houthi strikes launched from Yemen. The attacks disrupted fuel exports through the Red Sea’s Bab al‑Mandeb strait and marked a major escalation in the Iran–Saudi conflict fought through the Yemen war. Imaged 26 July 2026. [Photo: Gallo Images/Orbital Horizon/Copernicus Sentinel Data 2026/Getty Images] Instead, this dip was a short-term response to the high oil prices and supply chain snags caused by the Iran war. And that means we have more to do to expand clean energy and stop the surge in plant-warming greenhouse gas emissions. “A decline in fossil CO2 emissions is encouraging, but a reduction driven partly by geopolitical shocks is not a sustainable climate solution,” Pierre Friedlingstein, director of the Global Carbon Budget Office at the University of Exeter and leader of the study, said in a statement . The situation mirrors what happened after the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic, when lockdowns that halted commutes and shuttered businesses led to a record drop in carbon emissions . That drop came about not because of a push toward smart climate policies, but because of one destabilizing event. There was no indication then that this drop in emissions would continue year over year, which is what’s required to decrease emissions enough to meet climate goals. The impact of the war in Iran brings the same threat: that the world will return to its fossil fuel business-as-usual behavior once oil prices drop and supply chain issues are solved.  Bill Hare, CEO of Climate Analytics, doesn’t even consider this change in emissions a decline. It’s a “flatline,” he said in a statement, with the 0.4% drop “statistically indistinguishable from zero.” “The clean energy transition is delivering real gains: solar, wind and electric vehicles are now offsetting roughly two-thirds of the emissions growth from rising energy demand,” he added. “But those gains are being swallowed by continued and growing fossil fuel use elsewhere: in industry, in emerging economies, and across sectors where the energy transition has barely begun.” The dangers of fossil fuels have been a major topic at the COP31 climate talks. In his opening address, United Nations climate chief Simon Stiell said that the crisis of high fossil fuel prices is “spreading inflation like a cancer.” UN Secretary General António Guterres made similar comments, noting that fossil fuels don’t only drive the climate crisis, they come with steep economic and security costs—as the conflict in Iran illustrates.  “Across 130 countries, petrol prices have risen by around 26%—and diesel by 38%. Families, businesses, and governments are paying the price,” he said. And oil companies are raking in billions, he added. “Changing suppliers will not eliminate this exposure,” he continued. “The only answer is to reduce dependence itself—through clean energy, grids, storage, efficiency and electrification.” Though this slight drop isn’t a sign that our fossil fuel emissions have peaked, the researchers note, the emissions that were avoided because of clean energy technologies like solar and wind are “substantial.” If we can keep accelerating clean energy deployment, they add, “a sustained peak and decline in global CO2 emissions could be a few years away.”

title: Davao accountant can’t confirm own signature, tests senator-judges’ patience
zh_title: 达沃会计师无法确认自己的签名，考验参议员法官的耐心
summary: 11 月 9 日星期一，副总统萨拉·杜特尔特 (Sara Duterte) 的弹劾审判重新开始，参议员法官们不得不面对检方所说的达沃市评估员海梅·阿达林 (Jaime Adalin) 的“猛然觉醒”，他是辩方证人，最初在前往中国的问题上撒了谎。由于这起事件对参议员法官来说仍然记忆犹新，其中两位法官，文森特·“蒂托”·索托三世和潘菲洛·“平”·拉克森，于 11 月 10 日星期二要求弹劾法庭提醒证人，如果他们宣誓撒谎，他们将面临的处罚。对于审判的所有其他证人来说，这是公平的警告，
content:
11 月 9 日星期一，副总统萨拉·杜特尔特 (Sara Duterte) 的弹劾审判重新开始，参议员法官们不得不面对检方所说的达沃市评估员海梅·阿达林 (Jaime Adalin) 的“猛然觉醒”，他是辩方证人，最初在前往中国的问题上撒了谎。由于这起事件对参议员法官来说仍然记忆犹新，其中两位法官，文森特·“蒂托”·索托三世和潘菲洛·“平”·拉克森，于 11 月 10 日星期二要求弹劾法庭提醒证人，如果他们宣誓撒谎，他们将面临的处罚。对于审判中的所有其他证人来说，这是公平的警告，每次有新证人出庭时，埃斯库德罗都会重复这一警告。萨马尔岛花园城市的城市评估员、Play视频工程师John Kenneth Enumerables似乎注意到了这一提醒，他的证词并未引发任何蔑视警告。但随后出现了第三位辩方证人，达沃市会计师文格林·巴詹 (Vangelin Bajan)。一向开朗的审判长弗朗西斯·“奇兹”·埃斯库德罗一度表达了沮丧，并以严厉的语气表示，由于巴詹对检方问题的“回避”回答，他的耐心正在“消失”。 “我的耐心正在消失，请原谅我，”埃斯库德罗告诉巴詹，并指导她回答问题。巴詹在回避什么？为了质疑她的可信度，众议院私人检察官梅·迪维纳格拉西亚 (Mae Divinagracia) 向市会计师询问了她之前担任 Ampil、Elise、Ciudadano, and Co. 合伙人的工作情况。
巴詹一再表示，她不记得曾担任该公司的合伙人。面对带有自己签名的文件，巴詹显得很困惑，她说，合伙章程和修订后的合伙章程确实包含了她的税号和与她相似的签名，但她仍然不记得签署过这些文件。有人还看到她看着辩护团队，想着该说些什么，迪维纳格拉西亚大声喊道。 “我记不起所有这些文件……但这是我的税务帐号和签名，”巴詹说。 Ampil、Elise、Ciudadano, and Co.（现为 Elises & Cuidadano）担任 Gencorp Industries Incorporated 和 Metro City Chow Foods Inc.（这两家与杜特尔特有联系的公司）的外部审计师。参议员兼法官温·张侨伟 (Win Gatchalian) 在庭审后期插话时表示，该公司也是副总统及其丈夫马纳塞斯·卡皮奥 (Manases Carpio) 的外部审计师。参议员法官们的沮丧情绪如此强烈，以至于连参议员法官利托·拉皮德也站起来表达了他对她的证词的看法，他说：“Naawa na ako sa inyo。Kaming dalawa ni Sen Lacson…Sa haba-haba nang halos maghapon na tanong ng mga senator-judge, halos Indiani 'nyo nasasagot。”  （我可怜你。我们俩，拉克森参议员和我……
参议员法官们问了好几个小时，而你却几乎没有给出任何答案。）巴詹的回答引发了参议员法官们的不满，他们在过去一天与另一位达沃市官员阿达林的经历后已经不耐烦了。“昨天，证人在笑，今天，这位证人却在回避。我们应该引用他们蔑视的言论来尊重弹劾法庭吗？因为在我看来，他们不尊重我们，”说。参议员兼法官拉菲·图尔福。 “也许，到了我们提供它们作为例子的时候了，”图尔福补充道。在参议员法官的追问下，市会计师承认自己是该公司的一员。她同样表示，她忘记了 2015 年离开公司的事。然而，参议员法官

【原文 English Original】
At the resumption of Vice President Sara Duterte ‘s impeachment trial on Monday, November 9, senator-judges had to contend with what the prosecution called a “rude awakening” in the person of Davao City Assessor Jaime Adalin , the defense witness who initially lied about a trip to China. With that incident still fresh on the minds of senator-judges, two of them, Vicente “Tito” Sotto III and Panfilo “Ping” Lacson , on Tuesday, November 10, asked the impeachment court to remind witnesses of the penalties they face if they lie under oath. It was fair warning for all other witnesses of the trial, which Escudero would repeat every time a new witness took the stand. Play Video Engineer John Kenneth Enumerables, city assessor of the Island Garden City of Samal, seemed to have heeded the reminder, and his testimony did not elicit any contempt warning. But then came the third defense witness, Davao City accountant Vingelin Bajan. At one point, the usually jovial presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero expressed frustration and said in a stern tone that his patience was “wearing thin” over Bajan’s “evasive” responses to the prosecution’s questions. “My patience is wearing thin, forgive me,” Escudero told Bajan, as she directed her to respond to questions. What was Bajan being evasive about? In challenging her credibility, House private prosecutor Mae Divinagracia asked the city accountant about her previous employment as a partner of the Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano, and Co. accounting firm.  Bajan repeatedly said she could not remember working as a partner of the firm. Confronted with documents bearing her own signatures, Bajan appeared confused, saying the Articles of Partnership and Amended Articles of  Partnership, indeed, contained her tax account number and signatures similar to hers, but still could not recall signing them. She was also seen looking at the defense team as she thought of what to say, which Divinagracia called out. “I can’t recall all of these documents…. But this is my tax account number and signatures,” Bajan said. Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano, and Co. — now Elises & Cuidadano — served as the external auditor of Gencorp Industries Incorporated and Metro City Chow Foods Inc., two companies linked to Duterte. Senator-judge Win Gatchalian said in his interjection later in the trial that the company is also the external auditor of the Vice President and her husband, Manases Carpio. Frustration among the senator-judges was so strong that even Senator-judge Lito Lapid stood up to manifest what he thought about her testimony as well, saying: “Naawa na ako sa inyo. Kaming dalawa ni Sen Lacson…. Sa haba-haba nang halos maghapon na tanong ng mga senator-judge, halos hindi ‘nyo nasasagot.”  (I pity you. Both of us, Senator Lacson and I…. The senator-judges have been asking for hours and you hardly gave any answers.) Bajan’s answers triggered senator-judges, who were already impatient following their experience with another Davao City official — Adalin — the past day. “Yesterday, the witness was laughing and today, this witness is being evasive. Should we cite them in contempt to respect the impeachment court? Because as I see it, they have no respect for us,” said Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo. “Maybe, it’s about that time we provide them as an example,” Tulfo added.  After being pressed by senator-judges, the city accountant admitted to being part of the firm. She likewise said she had forgotten leaving the firm in 2015. However, Senator-judge Joel Villanueva countered her statement, emphasizing that the Amended Articles of  Partnership included her signed affidavit of withdrawal.  “We’re practicing utmost patience with you. I hope you’ll help us help you,” said Villanueva.  The Senate impeachment court has repeatedly reminded witnesses against dodging questions during the trial. Earlier in the day, Senator-judge Sotto inquired about the possible sanctions for witnesses lying under oath, with Senator-judge Lacson citing Senate Resolution No. 39, establishing the court’s contempt powers.  “Yesterday was not a good day for the impeachment court, Mr. President, Mr. Presiding Officer, simply because we had a witness who smirked, who laughed, almost made a mockery of the impeachment trial,” Lacson said.  “We don’t want to have a repeat of that kind of testimony,” he added. Will the other witnesses finally heed the warning? – Rappler.com

title: The Honeypot That Might End the AI Boom
zh_title: 蜜罐可能会终结人工智能的繁荣
summary: 这篇文章发表在《每日展望》时事通讯上。在这里注册。考虑到人工智能如何导致了历史上最大规模的诈骗和欺诈事件，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋据报道被一个老式的蜜罐所困，这在某种程度上是适当的。 10月29日，《纽约时报》报道称，据美国情报机构称，黄与一名中国公民艾丽丝·黄（无亲属关系）有染，后者一直在向中国政府传递信息。然后在 11 月 6 日，《泰晤士报》报道称，黄是一名异性恋者。
content:
这篇文章发表在《每日展望》时事通讯上。在这里注册。考虑到人工智能如何导致了历史上最大规模的诈骗和欺诈事件，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋据报道被一个老式的蜜罐所困，这在某种程度上是适当的。 10月29日，《纽约时报》报道称，据美国情报机构称，黄与一名中国公民艾丽丝·黄（无亲属关系）有染，后者一直在向中国政府传递信息。然后在 11 月 6 日，《泰晤士报》报道说，黄是一名纯粹的间谍——国家安全部的资产。两天后，英伟达董事会开始调查。截至本文撰写时，黄发誓不会下台，并只承认对妻子不忠。 Nvidia 股价已经下跌，自本月初（撰写本文时）以来已下跌约 17%。收件箱中的潜在客户分析通过深入、渐进的报告超越噪音。注册 没有付费专区，没有程序化广告——只有报告。随时取消订阅。提交电子邮件即表明您订阅了我们的工作日早间通讯《每日展望》。这一丑闻可能会破坏人工智能繁荣的势头，其中一些领域已经陷入困境。这无疑说明了市场集中化的风险，这种风险在人工智能行业比几乎任何其他行业都更为极端。对于英伟达来说，这起丑闻发生在一个尴尬的时刻。
该公司处于人工智能热潮的中心：人工智能模型几乎全部运行在数据中心内的英伟达芯片上。该公司还进行了大量的“循环融资”，利用其利润以各种方式支撑其图形处理单元（GPU）（人工智能中使用的计算机芯片）的销售。它在人工智能实验室本身（例如 Anthropic 和 OpenAI）上投资了数百亿美元，刺激了对计算的需求。它已向 CoreWeave 等数据中心公司追加了数十亿美元的投资，英伟达还向这些公司承诺斥资 63 亿美元购买 2032 年之前未售出的计算能力。这些“neocloud”公司似乎是人工智能热潮中的弱点。他们一直以高利率大量借贷，以建设可以出租容量的数据中心。如果未来的计算需求没有足够的数量来偿还贷款，或者如果公众对数据中心的强烈反对导致其项目的延迟和取消成本足够高，那么新云就会破产。信用违约掉期市场（基本上是一种企业保险）表明，华尔街交易员认为 CoreWeave 在未来五年内破产的可能性约为二分之一。如果发生这种情况，英伟达将损失大量销售额，其以巨额利润支撑行业其他公司的能力也将大大降低。这种动力显然可以自我维持。
这也几乎正是 2000 年代初互联网泡沫崩溃的方式，债务推动下疯狂铺设数千万英里的光纤电缆，然后这些光纤电缆在五年内大部分闲置。尽管确实存在人工智能商业模式，但从财务角度来看，底层基础设施建设似乎越来越有可能超出其滑雪板。人工智能眨眼的一周？现在事实证明，事情的中心人物被一个愚蠢的中国间谍诱骗了，就像 20 世纪 60 年代的詹姆斯·邦德电影中那样。我们还不知道间谍到底告诉了北京什么

【原文 English Original】
This article was featured in the Daily Prospect newsletter. Sign up for it here. It is somehow appropriate, given how artificial intelligence has enabled the greatest explosion of scams and frauds in history, that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was reportedly entrapped by a good old-fashioned honeypot. On October 29, The New York Times reported that, according to American intelligence agencies, Huang had been having an affair with a Chinese national, Alice Huang (no relation), who had been passing information to the Chinese government. Then on November 6, the Times reported that Huang was a straight-up spy—a Ministry of State Security asset. Two days later, the Nvidia board started an investigation. As of this writing, Huang has vowed not to step down, and has admitted only to cheating on his wife. Nvidia shares have fallen off, down about 17 percent since earlier in the month at time of writing. The Prospect in your inbox Analysis that goes beyond the noise with in-depth, progressive reporting. Sign up No paywall, no programmatic ads — just the reporting. Unsubscribe anytime. Submitting your email signs you up for The Daily Prospect, our weekday morning newsletter. The scandal might break the momentum of the AI boom, some sectors of which were already reeling. It certainly illustrates the risk of market concentration, which is more extreme in the AI industry than in nearly any other. The scandal comes at an awkward time for Nvidia. The company is at the center of the AI boom: AI models almost all run on Nvidia chips inside the data centers. The company has also carried out a tremendous quantity of “circular financing,” using its profits to prop up its sales of graphics processing unit (GPUs), the computer chips used in AI, in various ways. It invested tens of billions in the AI labs themselves (like Anthropic and OpenAI), stoking demand for compute. It has invested billions more in data center companies like CoreWeave, to which Nvidia also committed $6.3 billion to buy any unsold compute capacity through 2032. These “neocloud” companies look to be the weak spot of the AI boom. They have been borrowing heavily, at high interest rates , to build out data centers whose capacity can be rented out. If future compute demand is not there in sufficient quantity to pay back the loans, or if the immense popular backlash against data centers causes sufficiently expensive delays and cancellations of their projects, then the neoclouds will go bankrupt. The credit default swap market—basically a kind of corporate insurance—indicates that Wall Street traders think there is a maybe 1-in-2 chance that CoreWeave will go bankrupt over the next five years. If that happens, Nvidia will lose a large block of sales, and its ability to prop up the rest of the industry with mega-profits will be much reduced. That’s a dynamic that could obviously feed on itself. This is also almost exactly how the dot-com bubble collapsed in the early 2000s, with a madcap debt-fueled rush to lay tens of millions of miles of fiber-optic cable that then sat mostly unused for half a decade. Though there is certainly an AI business model out there, it looks increasingly likely that the underlying infrastructure build-out has gotten way out over its skis, finance-wise. The Week AI Blinked? And now it turns out that the man at the center of it got honeypotted by a dadgummed Chinese spy, like in some middling James Bond movie from the 1960s. We don’t know yet exactly what the spy told Beijing, but China does want as many of the most advanced chips as it can possibly get, which have been subject to American export controls since 2022. Nvidia naturally would like to sell as many GPUs as possible, and the Chinese market would be bigger than any but the American one. I don’t need to get out yarn and a corkboard to illustrate the potential behavior there. At any rate, somewhat to my surprise, intelligence officials showed this evidence to the top echelon of the Trump administration earlier this year, including the president, and they did nothing. That could be because Donald Trump, despite his constant racist fulminations against China, is the most corrupt president in history and he doesn’t care what kind of export controls a CEO might be helping foreign spies evade in return for, uh, certain favors. Or it could be that Nvidia is so central to the AI boom that Trump balked at doing anything that might endanger it. Whatever the case, the very fact that Nvidia is so centrally important to such a major sector greatly increases all kinds of risk. If there were another two or three GPU companies with similarly effective technology and some slack manufacturing capacity out there, customers could turn to an alternative, and one man’s indiscretion would not pose an immediate risk of an economic crisis. More competition almost certainly would have avoided much of the recent stupendous increase in GPU and memory prices, which have jacked up prices of all manner of electronic devices. Millions of gamers would not have been completely priced out of the market, with a cutting-edge Nvidia graphics card now costing nearly $7,000 , if you can even find one. It’s hard to imagine such a world, however, given the extreme technical difficulty of cutting-edge GPU design and manufacturing, plus the fact that other companies like AMD have tried to compete with Nvidia and largely failed. A whole alternative software stack would have to have developed to compete with Nvidia’s proprietary CUDA program, or Nvidia would have to be forced to license it. But it simply should not be the case that one horny guy in a leather jacket is the only one who can build a computer chip, and if we had any sense, we would be building that world right now.
